A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Myneyrsh]] '''soldier''' served in the [[Vaklin insurgency]] against the forces of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In battle she wielded a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and wore a shift that covered most of her body.
